code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen = set()
    objects = []
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == 0 or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            stack = [(r, c)]
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while stack:
                y, x = stack.pop()
                cells.append((y, x))
                for q in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
                    yy, xx = q
                    if 0 <= yy < h and 0 <= xx < w and q not in seen and grid[yy][xx] == color:
                        seen.add(q)
                        stack.append(q)
            minr = min(y for y, x in cells)
            minc = min(x for y, x in cells)
            shape = frozenset((y-minr, x-minc) for y, x in cells)
            objects.append((color, cells, shape))
    refs = {}
    for color, cells, shape in objects:
        if color != 1:
            refs.setdefault(shape, color)
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for color, cells, shape in objects:
        if color == 1 and shape in refs:
            for y, x in cells:
                out[y][x] = refs[shape]
    return out
'''
